scope: Isolated native research, not an approved perceptual/listening protocol or product architecture decision

signalsmith_options.fft: Apple Accelerate via pinned Signalsmith Linear

sources: Versioned 1-second band-limited harmonic low/mid/high analytic probes; synthetic impulse, level step and 9-event ratio sweep; read-only frozen PR02 formant/noise/silence/missing-fundamental/bend/glide/bleed probes
controls: Immutable sample-indexed oracle ratio/F0 controls. Signalsmith aligned to its input-latency processing clock; Rubber Band incoming-source clock. Initial ratio set before padding/delay queries. No unreviewed tracker/whistle proposal as truth
latency: Raw output offset, startup pad/trim and native/callback availability clocks separate. Unity impulse correlation only; shifted amplitude-step timing uses RMS. Offline observer lookahead/dwell never backdated or called intrinsic latency
raw_format: Mono IEEE float32 WAV and native float32 payload, unchanged amplitudes; no per-voice normalization/limiter or automatic audio playback
correctness: Append-only artifacts, compiled source identity, canonical verified dependency trees, complete output/control timeline validation, deterministic transport control, FIFO wrap, fresh/reset native comparisons against frozen tolerances, source/binary fingerprints
negative_results: Native repeatability, accuracy, formant, allocation and timing failures remain failures even when adapter functional/sanitizer checks pass. Retain failed raw outputs and do not discard an engine family from one configuration
human_evidence: Development only. Explicit permission/hash-bound corpus selection and two completed registered agreeing human annotations required; current missing references remain pending. Uncertain frames excluded and expressive unstable frames reported separately, not tuned away
architecture_acceptance: pending; no product engine selected, no holdout access, install, Logic operation or distribution authorization
